newsitem.title: USA: Ponder says names Butler as new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Ponder says names Butler as new CEO.

text.p: Ponder Industries Inc said on Thursday it had elected Eugene Butler as its new chief executive officer, succeeding Larry Armstrong who earlier resigned to pursue other interests.
Mr. Butler, 55, was named a Ponder director, executive vice president and chief financial officer in April 1996.

Ponder Industries is an international oil field service and rental tool company that specializes in the use of fishing tools for the recovery of unwanted obstructions in the bore holes of oil and gas wells.
